style_context: Libraries, reading comprehension, book discovery, literacy service projects, and practical reading skills

images.description: Instructional library scene showing a Scout in a clean field uniform comparing a library catalog screen entry to the call number label on a nonfiction book spine, with short callouts highlighting title, author, call number, and matching shelf label; real public library shelves, no logos, no branding, text-light annotations only
images.value: Shows how catalog information matches the call number on a real book spine and shelf label, a visual connection text alone cannot make instantly clear

images.description: Instructional scene of a Scout in a clean field uniform sorting donated books on a table into clearly separated boxes by age level and type before delivery to a community partner, with short callouts marking inspect condition, sort by age, and box for delivery; indoor community room, no visible brand names, no decorative text
images.value: Shows the physical sorting workflow and category setup for a book drive, a process layout that prose alone cannot teach as clearly
